_comment: Object storage where no machine-readable source exists. AWS, Azure, GCP
and OCI are collected live. Hetzner Object Storage is DELIBERATELY ABSENT:
it exists (EU-only: nbg1/fsn1/hel1) but its prices render client-side and
could not be verified — omitted rather than guessed.
Two models coexist: per-gb (pay for what you store) and subscription
(base fee with included storage, then overage).

notes: Zero egress on every storage class — the pairing that makes R2 the structural outlier.
Free tier: 10 GB-month storage, 1M Class A and 10M Class B operations per month.
Class A = writes/lists, Class B = reads. Infrequent Access tier is $0.01/GB with retrieval fees.
"$6.95 / TB / mo" read off the pricing page 2026-08-18 — note this is HIGHER than the $6/TB widely cited; Backblaze has repriced.
Transactions are free ("Free transactions" on the pricing page); egress free to 3x average stored bytes, then $0.01/GB.
"$5.00 per month… includes 250 GiB of storage… additional storage costs $0.02 per GiB per month" — DO docs, read 2026-08-18.
Subscription also bundles 1 TiB/month outbound transfer shared across buckets; overage $0.01/GiB.

UNVERIFIED TODAY: Akamai's pricing pages render client-side and printed no numbers on 2026-08-18 or 2026-10-08. These are the long-published figures ($5/month, 250 GB and 1 TB outbound included, $0.02/GB overage) carried forward pending re-verification.
Same thing as "$0.02/GB with a $5/month minimum": 250 GB x $0.02 = $5. Enabling Object Storage adds 1 TB to the account's pooled outbound transfer.
Standard tier: $18.00/month minimum, which includes 1000 GB stored and 1000 GB/month outbound; $0.018/GB stored and $0.01/GB transferred beyond that. Product page FAQ, read 2026-10-08.
Premium ($36), Performance ($50), Accelerated ($100) and Archival ($6) tiers exist; Standard is the general-purpose comparable.
Offered in 14 storage-hub locations, which include New Jersey, Los Angeles and Singapore but not Frankfurt, so there is no eu-central entry.
